title: build.yml
description: The per-repo build contract, .github/build.yml. Documentation, and the source for the reader's key list; it is not run in CI. contract/validate.jq is what enforces it. Defaults filled in by contract/read.sh: node 24 (next, spa), go 1.27 (go), booleans false, go-dir '.', go-main ./cmd/<repo name>. The `dockerfile` output is the shared dockerfiles/<family>.Dockerfile in workspace-ci for next/spa/go; for custom it is the `dockerfile` value verbatim, a path relative to the build context. For the shared families it is informational only (absolute on the runner that read it): app.yml and scripts/build-image compute their own Dockerfile path.

dockerfile.description: Custom only. Path relative to the repo root (build context), no leading / or ..

node.description: Node major. Emitted as a string.

go.description: Go minor, e.g. "1.27". Must be quoted (unquoted 1.30 would parse as 1.3).

favicon.description: Paths relative to the repository root (the checkout), NOT to `path`. An empty list means none.

build-args.description: Public build args only (the non-secret rule). Not allowed with family go. Passed to next, spa and custom builds as one ARG, PUBLIC_BUILD_ENV_B64 (base64 of the K=V lines); a custom Dockerfile must declare and decode it.

coolify-app.description: Coolify application uuid(s): 8-64 lowercase letters and digits. release.yml interpolates it into authenticated API URLs.

smoke-args.description: Word-split into docker run flags: no spaces inside one argument. As trusted as the repo's own CI code.

go-main.description: go only. Package go build builds. Default ./cmd/<repo name>.
